LESSON: SIMILARITY AND ENLARGEMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.2 Scale Drawing (14 lessons) • Compass and true bearings • Bearing of
Topic 4.3: Similarity and Enlargement
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Similarity and Enlargement, part of Geometry 4.2 Scale Drawing (14 lessons) • Compass and true bearings • Bearing of in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: What are similar objects? 2. How do we use enlargement in real-life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Similarity and Enlargement together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: as the learner draws similar and enlarged objects and figures.

● Digital Literacy: as the learner learns and uses digital devices to enlarge objects and figures.

Values:
● Responsibility: learner collects similar objects and takes care of them in the learning process.

● Social Cohesion: learner works in groups to draw similar objects and figures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental Education: learner collects similar objects from the environment.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Pre-Technical Studies: contributes to learner’s scale-drawing skills of similar figures and objects.
